# Gothic Advent: Zürich (images)

Processed images for the *Gothic Advent: Zürich* TRMNL plugin, served by GitHub Pages at
https://verb.github.io/trmnl-gothic-advent/images/

File names: `<slot>[-n<number>][-c<candles>]-<x|og>.png`, where `x` is TRMNL X (1872×1404, 16 grays) and
`og` is TRMNL OG (800×480, 1-bit). They are generated; do not edit by hand.

This repo only uses `images/`, `index.html`, `.nojekyll` and `.github/`, so it can be merged into the
source repository later without conflicts.
